Grew Up Facing Prejudice.name: Grew Up Facing Prejudice
Grew Up Facing Prejudice.description:
🛡️ You grew up with stares, insults and closed doors: as a heteromorph, as someone born Quirkless or with a Quirk people call villainous.

🧱 You learned to hold your ground.
👁️ You can tell kindness from pity.

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Willpower +5, Insight +5
Grew Up Facing Prejudice.traitNarrativeEffects: It depends on the character. Heteromorph (Mutant Type): stares, people crossing the street, refused service, landlords and other parents calling them dangerous, open hostility in some rural towns. Quirkless: pity, bullying, teachers and doctors urging them to give up heroics, a class joke from age four. Neither: a Quirk people called villainous or frightening. In play: most people in Musutafu and at U.A. are polite; some are not. The narrator shows it in small fitting moments (a double take, a clerk's hesitation, a reporter's angle, a hero assuming the worst) and shows people who do better. Willpower and Insight help read and withstand it, not end it. Pressure: villain and extremist recruiters seek this history, offering belonging and a target for anger; allies, mentors and others like them offer another way; the narrator surfaces both, the player decides. Childhood: safe places, a neutral face, whispers, the few who treated them as ordinary.
